data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on a shared limit? With 100 tons now, I propose 18 tons each this month: we each earn $18,000 and leave 10 tons, avoiding collapse. Next month’s stock would be either 100 or 20—not a guaranteed refill. Going forward, let’s each take the whole-number amount we get by dividing the stock above a 10-ton reserve by five, rounding down. If we start with 20, that means 2 tons each. We can review everyone’s catches afterward and adjust together. John, would you agree to that?
